description: Read an evaluation job by its job_id. While the job runs this gives the status (QUEUED or RUNNING) and the progress. When the job fails it gives the error. When the job completes it gives the aggregated report: the summary text, the average conversation and turn scores, the highlights and the top failure categories. There is no separate summary call: a completed job already carries that report. For the per-conversation transcripts and per-turn labels, take the ids from `eval_ids_by_score` and call mba_get_eval_details. This tool adds a `details` key when it can read those ids for you.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_eval_results

outputSchema.description: Current job status and results (if completed)

details.description: The details of each conversation. Only a COMPLETED job has them.

creation_time.description: Unix timestamp when the evaluation was created

custom_success_criteria.description: JSON array of client-specified success criteria strings

eval_case_id.description: ID of the eval case that defined the scenario and success criteria

per_turn_labels.description: JSON array of per-turn label integers

reasons.description: JSON array of {category, score, description, recommended_actions} objects

score.description: Overall evaluation score from the judge LLM

transcript.description: JSON object with system_prompt and transcript_turns for the evaluated conversation

update_time.description: Unix timestamp when the evaluation was last updated

error.description: Error details when status is FAILED

progress.description: Progress information while the job is running

current_stage.description: Current pipeline stage. Known values: simulation, evaluation, insights, done.

total.description: Total number of eval cases in the job

result.description: Full result payload when status is COMPLETED

creation_time.description: Unix timestamp when the insight report was created

eval_ids_by_score.description: JSON object grouping evaluation IDs by score

highlights.description: JSON array of highlight objects with description and evaluation IDs

summary.description: Natural-language summary of overall agent performance

summary_id.description: The unique identifier for the summary report

top_failure_categories.description: JSON array of failure category objects with category, evaluation IDs, and recommended actions

update_time.description: Unix timestamp when the insight report was last updated

status.description: Job status. Known values: QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED.

title: Read evaluation results
